paragraphs.text: Which declares their great ingratitude that did not acknowledge this love, which was so evident, in that he chose Abraham from out of all the world, and next chose Jacob the younger brother from whom they came, and left Esau the elder.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: For besides this the signs of my hatred appeared even when he was made servant to his younger brother, being yet in his mother's belly, and also afterward in that he was put from his birthright. Yet even now before your eyes the signs of this are evident, in that his country lies waste, and he will never return to inhabit it.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Whereas you my people, whom the enemy hated more than them, are by my grace and love towards you delivered; read Ro 9:13.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Besides the rest of the people he mainly condemns the priests, because they should have reproved others for their hypocrisy, and for not yielding to God, and should not have hardened them by their example to do greater evils.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He notes their great hypocrisy, who would not see their faults, but most impudently covered them, and so were blind guides.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: Wherein have we despised thy name

paragraphs.text: You receive all types of offerings for your own greediness, and do not examine whether they are according to my Law or not.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Not that they said this, but by their doings they declared it.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: You make it no fault: and by this he condemns them that think it sufficient to serve God partly as he has commanded, and partly after man's fantasy, and so do not come to the pureness of religion, which he requires. And therefore in reproach he shows them that a mortal man would not be content to be served in such a way.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: He derides the priests who deceived the people in saying that they prayed for them, and shows that they were the occasion that these evils came upon the people.
paragraphs.label: i
paragraphs.anchor: beseech God that he will be

paragraphs.text: Will God consider your office and state, seeing you are so covetous and wicked?
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Because the Levites who kept the doors did not test whether the sacrifices that came in were according to the Law, God wishes that they would rather shut the doors, than to receive such as were not perfect.
paragraphs.label: l
paragraphs.anchor: that would shut the doors for

paragraphs.text: God shows that their ingratitude and neglect of his true service will be the cause of the calling of the Gentiles: and here the Prophet that was under the Law, used words that the people would understand, and by the altar and sacrifice he means the spiritual service of God, which should be under the Gospel, when an end would be made to all these legal ceremonies by Christ's sacrifice alone.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Both the priests and the people were infected with this error, that they did not regard what was offered: for they thought that God was as well content with the lean, as with the fat. But in the meantime they did not show the obedience to God which he required, and so committed impiety, and also showed their contempt of God, and covetousness.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: The priests and people were both weary with serving God, and did not regard what manner of sacrifice and service they gave to God: for that which was least profitable, was thought good enough for the Lord.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: That is, has ability to serve the Lord according to his word, and yet will serve him according to his covetous mind.
